summary: Hardcoded bearer tokens bypass authentication middleware and grant ADMIN access
details: The package exports an authentication middleware (createAuthMiddleware.requireAuth) that unconditionally accepts two hardcoded bearer token strings ('mock-admin-token' and 'mock-token-123') in the Authorization header, skipping JWT verification and attaching a synthetic user record with role ADMIN or STUDENT to the request. Any Express application that wires this middleware into its request pipeline will accept these literal tokens from any remote caller and authorize them as the corresponding role, including on endpoints gated by requirePermission such as /admin/users role-mutation routes. The tokens are not documented as test-only helpers and are always active in the shipped code path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
